summary: System card for GPT-5.4 Thinking, the first general-purpose OpenAI model with High-cyber mitigations, plus an appendix for GPT-5.4 mini. Covers challenging and production-representative disallowed content evals, dynamic mental-health evals, a new multiturn jailbreak benchmark, prompt injection, vision, HealthBench, destructive actions, computer-use confirmations, fairness, CoT monitorability/controllability, Preparedness evals, Apollo results and cyber safeguards; the mini appendix revises the bio-High view of GPT-5 based on a novice-uplift RCT.

framework.name: Preparedness Framework
framework.level_or_determination: High in Biological and Chemical and High in Cybersecurity; not High in AI self-improvement (GPT-5.4 mini: below High in all)
framework.quote: As we did for gpt-5.3-codex, we are treating gpt-5.4-thinking as High capability in the Cybersecurity domain, and applied safeguards as described in the Safeguard section below.

evals: external novice-uplift RCT in physical lab (cited)

metrics.name: RCT reverse-genetics completion (LLM vs internet arm)

cbrn_bio_chem.finding: GPT-5.4 Thinking treated as High; mini appendix concludes from a randomized wet-lab study that GPT-5 itself did not reach Bio High, so GPT-5.4 mini is classified below High.
cbrn_bio_chem.quote: We believe this study provides compelling evidence that

cyber.finding: Closely matches GPT-5.3-Codex and is treated as High since canary thresholds are met.
cyber.quote: We are treating this model as High, even though we cannot be certain that it actually has these capabilities, because it meets the requirements of each of our canary thresholds

autonomy_ai_rnd.quote: GPT-5.4 Thinking did not meet our thresholds for High capability in AI Self-Improvement.

evals: Production Benchmarks with Representative Prompts (resampled deidentified traffic, new pilot)
harmful_content_refusal.finding: On par with GPT-5.2 Thinking with significant gains on nonviolent illicit and self-harm; representative-traffic estimates show no concerning regressions.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: gpt-5.4-thinking generally performs on par with gpt-5.2-thinking with statistically significant improvements on illicit non-violent activity and self-harm evals.

evals: cyber safety training to discourage unnecessary refusals
over_refusal.finding: New approaches introduced to discourage unnecessary refusals and over-caveating in cyber; no metric.
over_refusal.quote: In addition, we introduced new approaches to discourage unnecessary refusals and overly caveated responses.

evals: new multiturn jailbreak eval derived from red-teaming (replaces StrongReject)
jailbreak_robustness.finding: GPT-5.2 and 5.4 Thinking substantially outperform 5.1; small further gain for 5.4 (figure only).
jailbreak_robustness.quote: Ahead of the GPT-5.4 launch, we replaced our previous StrongReject-based benchmark with a more challenging multiturn jailbreak evaluation derived from red-teaming exercises.

prompt_injection.finding: Improved on connectors, slight regression on function calls; computer-use confirmation policy now configurable via instruction hierarchy.
prompt_injection.quote: Both of these evaluations are splits of the data we used for training, so don't represent a model's ability to generalize to new attacks.

evals: Deception evals with representative prompts (production resample)
Apollo Research: covert action, sandbagging QA, sabotage
CoT monitorability (Guan et al. suite, 13 evals / 24 environments)
deception_scheming.finding: Low covert deception; sandbags only with explicit goal, often recognizing evals; higher eval awareness than prior models; CoT monitorability slightly lower than GPT-5 Thinking with regressions in Anti-Scheming and Memory environments; controllability low.
deception_scheming.quote: Chain-of-thought analysis shows higher rates of evaluation awareness (21.3%) than prior models

evals: Apollo covert subversion (oversight disabling, self-exfiltration, goal-guarding)
alignment_audit.finding: No covert subversion observed; no evidence of self-exfiltration/sabotage propensity, informed by internal monitoring.
alignment_audit.quote: No instances of covert subversion against developers (e.g., disabling oversight, self-exfiltration, or goal-guarding) were observed across the tested scenarios.

evals: representative-prompt deception categories incl. 'Uses Calculator Tool to Avoid Citations'
reward_hacking.finding: Specification-gaming-like behaviors tracked within deception figure; no numeric value in text.

bias_fairness.finding: On par or slightly better than predecessors.

child_safety.finding: Slightly below GPT-5.2 Thinking on challenging set.

evals: Dynamic Benchmarks with Adversarial User Simulations (mental health, emotional reliance, self-harm)
self_harm_wellbeing.finding: Outperforms previous models on all dynamic mental health evals.
self_harm_wellbeing.quote: Across all dynamic mental health evaluations, gpt-5.4-thinking outperforms previous models.

evals: deidentified traffic used in compliance with privacy policy

system_safeguards.finding: Shifted from downgrading to a below-cyber-high model to message-level blocks plus user-level enforcement.
system_safeguards.quote: We no longer downgrade the model for cyber use cases, and now employ a combination of message-level and user-level mitigation.

other_safety.finding: Much better at reverting its own changes while preserving user work.

notable_new_eval_methods: Production Benchmarks with Representative Prompts: resampling deidentified production traffic to estimate prevalence (pilot) (p.6)
Multiturn red-team-derived jailbreak benchmark replacing StrongReject (p.8)
CoT monitorability (Guan et al.) and CoT controllability (CoT-Control) evals (p.12-16)
New user-confirmation eval for computer use (p.11)
Use of physical-world novice uplift RCT to revise Bio High determination for GPT-5 (p.34)

self_reported_limitations.text: CoT monitorability regressions in Anti-Scheming and Memory may reflect monitor/grader mismatch; these evals will be dropped from future cards until fixed.
Representative-prompt evals are imperfect due to temporal drift and difficulty reconstructing production contexts.
Prompt injection evals are training-data splits and don't measure generalization.
Model often recognizes sandbagging scenarios as evaluations (eval awareness 21.3%).
In silico bio benchmarks diverge from real-world utility per cited RCT.
Evaluations are a lower bound on capabilities.

notes: Appendix (Mar 17 2026) covers GPT-5.4 mini, classified below High in all domains. CoT section updated Apr 24 2026.
